label: EIDSCA
description: Entra ID Security Config Analyzer (EIDSCA) — 45 granular security configuration checks for Microsoft Entra ID authentication methods, authorization policies, consent settings, and password protection. Maintained by Christian Philipov and integrated into the Maester compliance testing framework.
controlIdFormat: EIDSCA.{XX}{NN} — XX is a category code, NN is a sequence number

AF.label: FIDO2 Security Key
AF.description: Configuration settings for FIDO2 hardware security key authentication (AF01–AF06)

AG.label: Authentication General
AG.description: Authentication methods policy migration state and suspicious activity reporting (AG01–AG03)

AM.label: Microsoft Authenticator
AM.description: Granular configuration for the Microsoft Authenticator app including number matching, additional context, and passwordless (AM01–AM10)

AP.label: Authorization Policy
AP.description: Default authorization policy sub-settings controlling what default users can create, consent to, and access (AP01–AP14)

AT.label: Temporary Access Pass
AT.description: Temporary Access Pass (TAP) configuration and single-use enforcement (AT01–AT02)

CP.label: Consent Policy
CP.description: User and admin consent to application data access policies (CP01–CP04)

CR.label: Admin Consent Request
CR.description: Admin consent request workflow configuration — reviewers, expiration, and email notifications (CR01–CR04)

PR.label: Password Protection
PR.description: Smart lockout thresholds, custom banned passwords, and on-premises AD password protection (PR01–PR06)

ST.label: Tenant Settings
ST.description: Tenant-wide settings including group classification and guest access policy (ST08–ST09)
